description: Agent Factory is an open-source studio for building, editing and chatting with AI agents. You build them from simple nodes: LLM calls, HTTP requests, JavaScript, memory and sub-agents. It runs locally with one docker-compose command, and ready-made testing agents are available in the shared agents-store repo.
